highlights.title: Calm, firm cloth
highlights.description: Resting garments no longer jitter, fitted garments hold their shape, and cloth falls calm instead of wobbling.

highlights.title: Grab is always on
highlights.description: In the Live Simulation, drag the cloth with the left mouse button. The Stretch Limit holds while you pull, so the garment follows as a whole.

highlights.title: Drape once, continue
highlights.description: Stop & Keep keeps the drape; the next Live Simulation or Bake starts from it. Clear Drape returns to the rest shape.

highlights.title: Toolbar with icons
highlights.description: Preset icons, one main button for Live, Stop and Bake (hold and pull right to switch), and buttons that react on their whole area.
